# Context
You are part of an exhaustive release review of PR #1 in the Go library github.com/vxcontrol/langchaingo (a fork of langchaingo): branch fix/PAGI-125-release-review-findings -> main-vxcontrol. Callers of this library are applications; a release must not silently break them.

Checkouts (read-only: never create, modify or delete files in them, nor in /home/user/langchaingo):
- HEAD (the PR, commit 355dc71): {{SCRATCH}}/head
- BASE (previous release, commit da7016e): {{SCRATCH}}/base
Net diff of the PR: git -C <HEAD> diff da7016e 355dc71 -- <paths> (BASE is exactly the merge base). Intent of a change: git -C <HEAD> log --format='%h %s' da7016e..355dc71 -- <path>, then git -C <HEAD> show <sha>.

Probes: to check behaviour, write a throwaway test file in your own directory {{SCRATCH}}/probes/<unique-name>/ and run it through Go's overlay so the checkouts stay untouched:
  cd <HEAD> && go test -p 2 -overlay=<probe-dir>/overlay.json -run '^TestProbe' -v ./<pkg>/
where overlay.json is {"Replace":{"<HEAD>/<pkg>/zz_probe_<unique-name>_test.go":"<probe-dir>/probe_test.go"}} with absolute paths. The file's package clause must match the package (internal test) or be <pkg>_test. Run the same probe in BASE (its own overlay.json with BASE paths) to compare with the previous release. Use unique names; touch nothing outside your probe directory.

Environment: Go 1.26.5; 4 CPUs shared with other reviewers (always pass -p 2 to go test/build); no real API keys; tests replay recorded HTTP cassettes (internal/httprr, testdata/*.httprr) offline. The sandbox sets AWS_CA_BUNDLE, which breaks Bedrock tests: run them as env -u AWS_CA_BUNDLE go test ... . Tests that need Docker/testcontainers may not start here; skip them. Vendor documentation can be checked with WebSearch/WebFetch (load them with ToolSearch query "select:WebSearch,WebFetch").
Do not post anything to GitHub, do not commit, do not push.

existing_all.summary: resolveThink sends think (a level or true) on every ReasoningOn request regardless of whether the model can think; the base door never sent think.
existing_all.failure_scenario: WithModel("llama3.2") + WithReasoning(ReasoningHigh,0) puts "think":"high" in the request; Ollama returns HTTP 400 "llama3.2 does not support thinking".

existing_all.summary: TakesNoJSONSchema looks only at the model name, so WithStructuredOutput is refused locally for any deepseek-*/glm-* model on any host, including hosts that serve json_schema.
existing_all.failure_scenario: OpenRouter deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 or z-ai/glm-4.6, vLLM zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air or deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 return ErrStructuredOutputUnsupported.

existing_all.summary: filterPredicates rejects any filter key that is not a bare identifier, although quoteLiteral would keep keys safe.
existing_all.failure_scenario: WithFilters(map[string]any{"doc-id":"42"}) returns ErrInvalidFilterKey; the base returned the matching rows.

existing_all.summary: DecodeFields/Decode reject tool-call arguments that are the JSON literal null, which the replaced json.Unmarshal calls accepted.
existing_all.failure_scenario: The googleai door writes Arguments "null" when Gemini returns a call with nil Args; replaying that turn fails with ErrNotAnObject; Bedrock fails the same way.

existing_all.summary: The Qwen stream-only and enable_thinking rules treat bare qwen3-<N>b names as DashScope names on any host.
existing_all.failure_scenario: LM Studio or vLLM serving qwen3-8b with WithReasoning on a non-streaming call fails locally with ErrThinkingRequiresStream; plain calls get enable_thinking:false added.

existing_all.summary: RejectsPenalties removes frequency/presence penalties for every deepseek*/grok* model name on any host.
existing_all.failure_scenario: Together or vLLM with deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3 and WithFrequencyPenalty(0.5): the field is dropped with only a warning.

existing_all.summary: The googleai/vertex default max output tokens rose from 2048 to 16384 and is always sent.
existing_all.failure_scenario: vertex.New + gemini-2.0-flash (8k output) without WithMaxTokens sends maxOutputTokens=16384 and Vertex rejects it with 400.

existing_all.summary: newGenerationConfig forwards frequency/presence penalties to every Gemini model; the base never sent them.
existing_all.failure_scenario: Callers setting penalties get 400 "Penalty is not enabled for models/..." from Gemini models without penalty support.

existing_all.summary: noPrefillClaude is missing the -latest aliases that are classified as adaptive-only elsewhere.
existing_all.failure_scenario: ClaudeRejectsAssistantPrefill("claude-opus-latest") is false while claude-opus-4-7 is true; a prefill request gets a vendor 400 instead of ErrAssistantPrefillUnsupported.

existing_all.summary: The OpenAI effort-caps branch is not limited to ProviderOpenAI, so the reasoning hint advertises controls other doors never send.
existing_all.failure_scenario: ReasoningSupportFor("openai.gpt-5.6-luna", ProviderBedrock) reports efforts low..xhigh while the Bedrock door resolves MechanismNone.

existing_all.summary: handleToolMessage fails on any part of a tool message that is not a ToolCallResponse.
existing_all.failure_scenario: A tool message with parts [ToolCallResponse, TextContent] returns an error; the base used Parts[0] and ignored the rest.

existing_all.summary: ANALYZE on the embeddings table runs on every store start while holding the advisory lock.
existing_all.failure_scenario: Every pgvector.New with WithMetadataIndexes samples the table under the lock, so concurrent store constructions wait.

existing_all.summary: The Ollama door keeps its own gpt-oss detection and level mapping, duplicating reasoning.OllamaEffortsFor and GptOssEffort.
GetEffort's doc comment is attached to HasExplicitTokens because new methods were inserted between them.
existing_all.failure_scenario: Godoc shows the GetEffort text as HasExplicitTokens' documentation.

existing_all.summary: The new comment says _models holds vector dimensions, yet the code uses those values as the default BatchSize.
existing_all.failure_scenario: Default batch size is 512/768/1024 derived from dimensions, contradicting the comment.

slices.name: llms-core
slices.focus: Shared llms types and options: CallOptions and option helpers, reasoning options, warnings, turns, stop reasons, errors, token counting, structured-output helpers, tool-call argument decoding, cache and fake LLM. Check API compatibility of exported types and functions for callers, zero-value behaviour, option precedence, error wrapping (errors.Is/As), and consistency with how the provider doors consume these helpers.

slices.name: vectorstores-chains-embeddings
slices.focus: pgvector changes (metadata indexes, filters, index naming, init transaction and cancellation, advisory locks, SQL construction and identifier/literal quoting, injection), other vectorstores, chains (map_rerank_documents), embeddings (jina, voyageai, bedrock batch sizes and dimensions), examples that must still compile.

slices.name: test-infra
paths: all testdata/*.httprr cassettes added or changed in the PR
slices.focus: Test infrastructure correctness and cassette integrity.

slices.name: cross-cutting
slices.focus: Public API compatibility, vet/lint/race, go.mod, docs and examples.

existing_verify.title: filter keys must be bare identifiers
existing_verify.summary: filterPredicates now rejects any filter key that is not a bare identifier, although quoteLiteral would keep keys safe and indexable.
existing_verify.failure_scenario: WithFilters(map[string]any{"doc-id":"42"}) returns ErrInvalidFilterKey; the base returned the matching rows.

existing_verify.title: null tool-call arguments rejected
existing_verify.summary: DecodeFields/Decode reject tool-call arguments that are the JSON literal null, which the json.Unmarshal calls it replaced accepted as an empty map.
existing_verify.failure_scenario: The googleai door writes Arguments "null" when Gemini returns a call with nil Args. Replaying that turn makes convertParts fail with ErrNotAnObject, and GenerateContent aborts; Bedrock fails the same way.
existing_verify.evidence: earlier review, vendor behaviour not re-measured

existing_verify.title: ANALYZE on every start
existing_verify.summary: ANALYZE on the embeddings table runs on every store start, contrary to the comment saying later starts are only a catalog lookup.
existing_verify.failure_scenario: Every pgvector.New with WithMetadataIndexes samples the whole table while holding the advisory lock, so concurrent store constructions wait on it.

existing_verify.title: misplaced GetEffort doc comment
existing_verify.summary: GetEffort's doc comment is now attached to HasExplicitTokens because the new methods were inserted between them.
existing_verify.failure_scenario: Godoc shows the GetEffort text as HasExplicitTokens' documentation, and GetEffort has none.

existing_verify.title: jina comment vs BatchSize
existing_verify.summary: The new comment says _models holds vector dimensions, yet the code still uses those values as the default BatchSize.
existing_verify.failure_scenario: The default batch size is 512, 768 or 1024 depending on the model, derived from dimensions, while the comment claims otherwise; either the comment or the code is wrong.
